subject: Deal readiness checklist, ownership, and evaluation probes
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deal readiness checklist, ownership, and evaluation probes

Clara / Allen —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I put together a short "deal readiness" checklist so we can agree who owns which acceptance items and what we’ll run during the evaluation sprint. I attached a working MAP (MAP-v1.xlsx) — it’s intentionally concise so we can iterate.

High-level asks:
- Can procurement confirm target contract execution week (EOW) so we can align cutover dates?
- Can you confirm the security owner who will complete the questionnaire and where to send evidence?

Proposed acceptance/exit gates (draft):
1) Smoke functional: API responses for canonical flows completed with no failures in 2 consecutive days.
2) Performance: 95th pctl latency under 300ms at target concurrency (50 rps).
3) Quality: 200-sample prompt set, concordance >= 92% vs. baseline.
4) Operational: KV cache warm start and autoscaling validated (1m ramp).

Owners (draft):
- Redwood infra validation: Karthik Iyer
- Onboarding & success: Monica Patel
- Novacorp security: Clara Zhou (TBD)
- Procurement/Legal: Allen Park / Novacorp Procurement

If that looks reasonable I’ll update the MAP and send a version with explicit milestone dates.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Aditya —

Appreciate the concise map. A couple quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

1) For the quality gate: what do you mean by "concordance"? Is that token-level similarity, classification accuracy on labeled prompts, or a human-annotated judgment? We need a clear pass/fail metric.
2) Performance target: 50 rps is fine, but what hardware is that validated on (GPU type / cloud region)? We’ll need this to map to our SRE load tests.
3) Security owner: I will own the questionnaire. Please send the SOC2 snippets and the recommended evidence list to procure@novacorp.com and security@novacorp.com.

Can you also include an explicit escalation contact for on-call incidents during the pilot?

Thanks,
Clara
Director, AI Platform | Novacorp

Cc: Allen Park <allen.park@novacorp.com>

Subject: Re: Deal readiness checklist, ownership, and evaluation probes

Clara — good questions. I sketched out specific, testable acceptance definitions below and attached a short runbook (redwood-eval-tests.md) with smoke scripts. Happy to walk the team through any of these.

Acceptance tests (proposed, pass criteria):
- Functional smoke (owner: Monica): 10 canonical scenarios exercised via REST and streaming endpoints with 0 critical errors for 48h.
- Throughput stability (owner: Karthik): sustained 50 rps for 10 minutes with 99th pctl error rate < 0.5% and 95th pctl latency <= 300ms. Test run on g4dn.xlarge (we can shift to your preferred hardware; call out region).
- Quality concordance (owner: Monica + Clara): 200-sample set scored by rubric; >= 92% exact-or-acceptable per rubrics in sheet (I can export annotated examples). If any category falls below 85% we trigger a remediation sprint.
- Regression safety (owner: Karthik): no increase >2% in hallucination/error rate vs. baseline on the same prompts.
- Operational readiness (owner: Karthik): active KV cache warm start validated; autoscaler responds within 60s for a 2x traffic spike.

Escalation contacts:
- L1 on-call (engineering): karthik@redwood.com
- L2 product/CS: monica@redwood.com
- Exec escalation: aditya@redwood.com

I’ve attached redwood-eval-tests.md — it describes the exact API calls we’ll run and the expected payloads so you can map to internal SRE tooling.

If everyone agrees, I’ll bake these into MAP-v1 and add milestone dates.

—Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
